accepted_rust_seams.event_batch: EventBatch { events:Vec<WindowEvent>, pending:bool }; WindowEvent includes InputReset { all_keys_up, all_buttons_up }. Sequence ordering preserves accepted events, then QueueFault, InputReset, and any latched CloseRequested. Motion loss is limited to explicitly counted pointer-move/resize/scale snapshots under saturation; no key/button/text/scroll/magnify/focus/close/action/tick loss.

binding_pins_and_declarations.macos13_availability: Audit SDK evidence is Xcode MacOSX27.0, so it does not itself prove macOS 13 runtime. Use only long-standing AppKit/Foundation declarations in this lane: sharedApplication, activateIgnoringOtherApps (audit explicitly prefers it over macOS-14 activate/yieldActivation), finishLaunching, nextEventMatchingMask, sendEvent, stop, NSWindow backingScaleFactor/convertRectToScreen, NSTextInputClient, NSTimer invalidate, and CGDisplayBounds. Audit lists binding/symbol declaration lines; exact SDK excerpts are in symbols.json and availability-provenance.json. Before implementation, inspect each declaration's enclosing availability annotation against the macOS 13 SDK; any symbol newer than 13 must be excluded or guarded. No call may infer deployment availability from objc2 feature presence.
binding_pins_and_declarations.exception: objc2 catch-all feature is pinned/enabled in rust/crates/vexel-platform-apple/Cargo.toml; it translates Objective-C exceptions at objc2 message sends for guard_native_call to catch. It does not cover raw C/CF, retain/release, cleanup, or panic=abort. Do not use macOS 14 activate/yieldActivation.

known_gaps: No NSTextInputClient implementation exists. Must implement all required marked/selected range, insert/unmark, attributed substring, candidate rectangle, character index and command-selector behavior with checked UTF-8/UTF-16 conversion.

Current queue is linked-list 256 events, coalesces by any queued same event type and returns false on full; callers ignore failures. Current timer has one global raw platform_window pointer. Neither policy is safe for the Rust multi-window contract.

Legacy coordinate and scroll details need compatibility tests; use finite top-left logical points, retain precise point coordinates/deltas, and keep backing pixel extents/scale separate. Current UI permits integer backing scale 1..=3; reject unsupported values rather than truncate.

guard_native_call does not fence foreign exceptions from raw C/CF or cleanup. Keep those calls out of callback-critical paths or state the unavoidable termination behavior; never claim catch_unwind alone fences Objective-C exceptions.
